QRC interoperability decoder adapted from valenbine/LRC-GET (MIT), src/des-helper.js. Original algorithm references WXRIW/QQMusicDecoder and SuJiKiNen/LyricDecoder.
Resources/qrc-des.js removes ES module exports and adds a byte-array bridge for the system JavaScriptCore runtime. No Node.js or external service required.
Source: https://github.com/valenbine/LRC-GET/blob/master/src/des-helper.js
